sentence: It is _____ to park here. You will get a fine.
hint: Think about the negative prefix for words starting with L
explanation: LEGAL → illegal (prefijo il-: que no es legal)

sentence: The instructions were _____. Nobody could understand them.
hint: Think about the negative prefix meaning 'not'
explanation: CLEAR → unclear (prefijo un-: que no es claro)

sentence: She was _____ to finish the project on time.
explanation: ABLE → unable (prefijo un-: que no es capaz)

sentence: I need to _____ my essay before submitting it.
explanation: WRITE → rewrite (prefijo re-: volver a escribir)

sentence: The company decided to _____ the old building.
explanation: BUILD → rebuild (prefijo re-: volver a construir)

sentence: I _____ with your opinion on this matter.
explanation: AGREE → disagree (prefijo dis-: lo opuesto de estar de acuerdo)

sentence: The old bridge has _____. We need a new one.
hint: The opposite of appear, in past tense
explanation: APPEAR → disappeared (prefijo dis-: dejar de aparecer, + pasado -ed)

sentence: This chair is very _____. You can sit in it for hours.
explanation: COMFORT → comfortable (sufijo -able: que tiene la cualidad de ser cómodo)

sentence: The food at that restaurant is always _____.
explanation: ENJOY → enjoyable (sufijo -able: que se puede disfrutar)

sentence: Is this water _____? I am very thirsty.
explanation: DRINK → drinkable (sufijo -able: que se puede beber)

sentence: The _____ of the city has grown a lot in recent years.
explanation: POPULAR → popularity (sufijo -ity: el estado de ser popular)

sentence: We need to use _____ when we drive.
explanation: ELECTRIC → electricity (sufijo -ity: la cualidad o el estado)

sentence: The _____ of the situation made everyone nervous.
explanation: SERIOUS → seriousness (sufijo -ness: la cualidad de ser serio)

sentence: His behaviour was completely _____. I could not believe it.
hint: Not acceptable — combine a prefix and a suffix
explanation: ACCEPT → unacceptable (prefijo un- + sufijo -able: que no se puede aceptar)

sentence: The damage to the car was _____. It could not be fixed.
explanation: REPAIR → irreparable (prefijo ir- + sufijo -able: que no se puede reparar)

sentence: She showed great _____ during the competition.
explanation: CREATIVE → creativity (sufijo -ity: la cualidad de ser creativo)

sentence: The weather is very _____ this week. It changes every hour.
explanation: PREDICT → unpredictable (prefijo un- + sufijo -able: que no se puede predecir)

sentence: They plan to _____ the kitchen next summer.
explanation: DECORATE → redecorate (prefijo re-: volver a decorar)

sentence: The _____ of the new product was a great success.
explanation: AVAILABLE → availability (sufijo -ity: el estado de estar disponible)

sentence: He felt a sense of _____ after losing the match.
explanation: DISAPPOINT → disappointment (sufijo -ment: el estado de estar decepcionado)
